info.name: TravelVIP — Dynamic Cabs (AIRPORT/OUTSTATION/RENTAL)
info.description:
Dynamic scenario template: OW/RT, multipax, connecting, SSR, then issue-ticket / status / detail / history / penalty / cancel.

Signing: resolve {{vars}} then HMAC-SHA256(body + timestamp).

Issue-ticket uses pricing bookingContext + priceId + searchIds, includeGst=true, and full gstDetails. Unique last-name tag and infant DOB are set in pre-request. Empty SSR vars are stripped so book still works without a seatmap.

RT domestic: Booking Status/Detail save flight_pnr_onward + flight_pnr_return from itinerary; cancel folders run Penalty/Cancel per leg PNR.

Hotel finalize uses Hilltop PAN (EUIPB1672M / Rohan Bhagat), the same gstDetails, and dates 2026-09-15/16.

A full Collection Runner WILL book live tickets if you run Issue Ticket / Finalize. Stop after Pricing/Prebook if you do not want that.

Auth: Partner Api 01 then 03 first.

Cab finalize + cancel require X-Partner-Key (partner access_token). Run Auth 01→03 first. Finalize books live on staging if executed.
